integrity: All proof and computational checks are contained in this package. The checker uses only the Python standard library; its finite shape enumeration does not independently certify infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Target frames are exactly two-/three-world reflexive chains; sources are finite rooted ancestor-order trees; count all maps, not only onto. Global maximizing tree shapes are not classified for arbitrary larger orders. Independent review not performed. Unindexed earlier enumerative work may cover parts of the claim.
source_ids: Goranko-Otto:Model Theory of Modal Logic, Handbook of Modal Logic (2007), section 2.2
title: Sharp failure of path maximality for bounded morphisms to two- and three-world chains
